subject: Post-demo: Budget bands, unit economics & founders slab request
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Mendez <ella@latticeai.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@latticeai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Budget bands, unit economics & founders slab request

Hi Ella / Tom — thanks again for the demo time earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

What we heard
- Primary workload: conversational assistant + embeddings for search (hybrid sync + streaming).
- Expected cadence: pilot month 1 then scale — ballpark monthly token range 4M–8M tokens for months 2–6.
- Target unit economics: you called out $200–$300 per 1M tokens as a target to make the ROI work for your current pricing model.
- Procurement: goal to have procurement/PO in place by Aug 10 so onboarding can start late Aug.

What we propose (baseline ask)
- Baseline hosted rate: $300 / 1M tokens (no commitment).
- Founders / startup slab ask: discounted starter slab for early-stage startups (one-time credit or % discount for first 3 months). You asked whether a founders slab + short commit could get you into the $200–$250 / 1M range.

Requests / next steps
1) Could you confirm expected monthly token burn during the first 3 months (pilot + scale)? A simple low/likely/high estimate is perfect.
2) Confirm procurement timeline (PO or MSA needed?). You noted finance tends to issue PO once the SOW is signed.
3) We will model two paths and propose exact numbers: (A) Founders slab (starter credits + 3-month discount) and (B) 12-month committed-use structure that targets your $/1M goal. Expect the worksheet attached (lattice_pricing_worksheet_v2.xlsx).

Attachments: lattice_pricing_worksheet_v2.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_latticeai.pdf

Thanks — I’ll loop in Kimberly for approval on the founders slab once you confirm the burn estimate.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Ella Mendez <ella@latticeai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@latticeai.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Budget bands, unit economics & founders slab request

Hi Sergio — great write-up, thanks. Quick answers below: 

Pilot burn (month 1): 1.2M tokens (proof-of-concept, low volume)
Pilot -> Scale (months 2–6): low 4M / likely 6M / high 8M tokens per month (we expect to hit likely in month 3–4 with some spikes for product launches).
Target unit: we’re ideally looking for ~$225 / 1M tokens net for the first 6 months to validate business case.
Procurement: Finance will do a PO once we have the SOW + MSA. Timeline: we can have a PO ready by 2027-08-10 if terms are in line with expectations.

A couple of asks: 
- Can you confirm if founders slab is a credit (one-time) vs percent off list? Which structure tends to eliminate lock-in risk for customers?
- If we do a 12-month committed use, what delta vs the founders slab should we expect? In other words: founders slab (short term) vs committed (12mo) — which gets us closer to $225 / 1M?

Thanks,
Ella
Ella Mendez
Head of Product | LatticeAI
ella@latticeai.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Budget bands, unit economics & founders slab request

Kimberly — Ella confirmed the burn bands and PO timeline. They want net ~$225 / 1M tokens for first 6 months to validate. Pilot month 1 will be small (1.2M) then likely 6M/mo. Procurement target is Aug 10 PO.

Suggested commercial paths to propose back to customer (quick sketch):
1) Founders slab (starter credits + temporary % off): 
   - Option A1: $300 baseline list -> provide 30% founders discount for first 3 months (effective $210 / 1M on billed tokens for month 1–3), plus $25k one-time onboarding credit to absorb spikes.
   - Option A2: 20% founders discount for first 6 months (effective $240 / 1M) with no upfront credit.
2) Committed 12-month: 12mo committed spend that gets them to target (~$225) depending on banding: e.g., commit to $X/month (equivalent token guarantee 5M/mo avg) -> effective blended $225 / 1M. Add a small multi-year sweetener for year 2 if they extend.

What I’m asking: can we approve a preliminary founders slab path to give Ella something concrete this week? I attached a drafted terms doc (proposed_slab_terms.docx) that I can refine with legal once you approve an exception for a larger founders discount.

If you want, I can also produce an explicit banding worksheet showing how a 5M/mo commit maps to $/1M.

Sergio

--- Forwarded message attached above ---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Mendez <ella@latticeai.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Budget bands, unit economics & founders slab request

Ella / Tom — thanks for the clear signals and the timeline. I reviewed Sergio’s sketch and we can make a provisional offer to help LatticeAI validate quickly. High-level offer below (subject to SOW / MSA and legal sign-off):

Provisional commercial offer (approved by RDW sales leadership):
- Baseline hosted list: $300 / 1M tokens.
- Founders slab (short-term accelerator): 30% off baseline for first 3 months (effective $210 / 1M on billed tokens months 1–3) + one-time $20,000 onboarding credit to offset pilot spikes.
- Commit path (12-month): if LatticeAI signs a 12-month committed-use agreement (minimum average 5M tokens / month guaranteed), we will price at an effective $225 / 1M across the committed term. This is structured as a blended rate tied to a committed token band; unused tokens have rollover / credit mechanics in the SOW.
- Multi-year sweetener: additional 5% discount in year 2 if they renew the committed arrangement.

Next steps: 
1) Sergio — send the revised pricing worksheet that maps Ella’s low/likely/high bands to the two options above.
2) If LatticeAI is ok with the provisional offer, we’ll have Legal prepare a short MOU + SOW and route to LatticeAI for PO/approval.
3) Aditya (onboarding) will prep an intake checklist and proposed kickoff week (target late Aug after PO).

Ella — this gets you into the ~$225 / 1M territory on a 12mo commit, and offers a steep founders discount to validate quickly without a lock-in risk. If this is acceptable I’ll route to contracts today and we can aim for an Aug 10 PO.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
